SSC CGL Online Form 2026 : Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level 17,727 Posts

Post Date: June 24, 2026 10:00 Am | Update Date: July 27, 2026

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Has Released A Notification On Its Official Website For The Recruitment Of Assistant Section Officer (ASO), Inspector (Central Excise, Income Tax, Preventive Officer), Sub Inspector (CBI, NIA), Assistant Enforcement Officer, Auditor, Accountant, And Junior Statistical Officer (JSO). This Recruitment Is For 17,727 Positions. SSC CGL Application Form Has Started On 24 June 2026 & The Candidates Can Apply Until The 27 July 2026. Minimum Age Is 18 Years & The Maximum Age Is 32 Years As On 01 August 2026. Candidates Must Check The Complete Details For SSC CGL Online Form 2026. Links Are Given Below. (Advt No. CGL-2026)

WhatsApp Telegram

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 24/06/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 27/07/2026 (11:00 PM)
  • Last Date Online Fee Payment : 28/07/2026
  • Correction Window Date : 10-11 August 2026
  • Tier-I Computer Based Exam : September - October 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : 100/-
  • SC / ST / PwBD : 0/- (Exempted)
  • All Category Female : 0/- (Exempted)
  • Correction Charge (First Time) : 200/-
  • Correction Charge (Second Time) : 500/-
  • Pay the Exam Fee Through Online Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI.

SSC CGL 2026 : Age Limit as on 01/08/2026

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years (Post Wise)
  • Maximum Age : 27 - 32 Years (Post Wise)
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per SSC Combined Graduate Level CGL 2026 Recruitment Rules (SC/ST: 5 Years, OBC: 3 Years, PwBD: 10 Years).

Total Vacancy

17,727 Posts
(Group B & Group C Central Govt Posts)
Staff Selection Commission SSC CGL 2026 : Vacancy Details & Eligibility
Post Name Total Posts SSC CGL Eligibility Criteria
Combined Graduate Level (CGL) 2026 (Various Posts) 17,727
  • Assistant Section Officer (ASO): Bachelor Degree in Any Stream from a Recognized University.
  • Junior Statistical Officer (JSO): Bachelor Degree in Any Subject with at least 60% Marks in Mathematics at 12th Standard OR Bachelor Degree with Statistics as one of the subjects.
  • Statistical Investigator Grade-II: Bachelor Degree in any subject with Statistics as one of the subjects.
  • All Other Posts (Inspector, Auditor, UDC, Tax Assistant): Bachelor Degree in Any Stream from a Recognized University in India.
How to Fill SSC CGL Online Application Form 2026
  1. Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Combined Graduate Level Examination (CGL 2026). Candidate Can Apply Between 24 June 2026 to 27 July 2026.
  2. Candidate must visit the new SSC official portal (ssc.gov.in) and complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not registered earlier.
  3. Live photo capture is mandatory through the SSC portal webcam / mobile app. Ensure proper lighting and neutral background.
  4. Kindly check and collect all required documents: Eligibility proof, ID proof, Address details, and Basic candidate details.
  5. Kindly ready scanned documents related to recruitment form: Photo, Signature, ID Proof, etc.
  6. Before submitting the application form, candidate must check the preview and verify all columns carefully.
  7. If candidate is required to pay the application fee, payment must be completed before the deadline. Forms without fee will not be processed.
  8. Take a printout of the final submitted form for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) : SSC CGL 2026

Q 1. What is the last date to apply online for SSC CGL 2026?

Ans. The last date to submit the online application for SSC CGL 2026 is 27 July 2026 up to 11:00 PM.

Q 2. What is the total number of vacancies announced in SSC CGL 2026?

Ans. A total of 17,727 Group B and Group C vacancies have been announced across central ministries and departments.

Q 3. What is the educational qualification required for SSC CGL 2026?

Ans. Candidate must hold a Bachelor Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute in India.

Q 4. What is the application fee for female candidates in SSC CGL 2026?

Ans. All female candidates, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are fully exempted from paying the application fee (Rs 0/-).

Q 5. Where can candidates fill out the SSC CGL 2026 application form?

Ans. Eligible candidates can apply directly on the new official portal of Staff Selection Commission at ssc.gov.in.

(function() {
    function initStudyTopperNavigation() {
        var siteNav = document.getElementById('site-navigation');
        var menuBtn = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
        var mainNav = document.getElementById('primary-menu');
        var searchModal = document.getElementById('gp-search');

        if (!siteNav || !menuBtn) return;
        if (siteNav.dataset.stNavV2Initialized === 'true') return;
        siteNav.dataset.stNavV2Initialized = 'true';

        // 1. Mobile Hamburger Menu Toggle
        var lastMenuToggleTs = 0;
        function handleMenuToggle(e) {
            var now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastMenuToggleTs < 250) return;
            lastMenuToggleTs = now;
            if (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
            }
            var isCurrentlyToggled = siteNav.classList.contains('toggled');
            if (isCurrentlyToggled) {
                siteNav.classList.remove('toggled');
                menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                if (mainNav) mainNav.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                siteNav.classList.add('toggled');
                menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                if (mainNav) mainNav.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        menuBtn.addEventListener('click', handleMenuToggle);

        // 2. 'More' / Submenu Dropdown Controller
        var moreParents = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-has-children');
        moreParents.forEach(function(parentLi) {
            var toggleLink = parentLi.querySelector(':scope > a') || parentLi.querySelector('a');
            var subMenu = parentLi.querySelector(':scope > .sub-menu') || parentLi.querySelector('.sub-menu');
            var arrowSvg = parentLi.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-toggle svg') || parentLi.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-toggle');
            var lastToggleTs = 0;

            function toggleDropdown(e) {
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastToggleTs < 250) return;
                lastToggleTs = now;
                if (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                }
                var isOpen = parentLi.classList.contains('sub-menu-open') || (subMenu && subMenu.classList.contains('sub-menu-open'));
                if (isOpen) {
                    parentLi.classList.remove('sub-menu-open', 'sfHover');
                    if (toggleLink) toggleLink.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    if (subMenu) {
                        subMenu.classList.remove('sub-menu-open');
                        subMenu.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    }
                    if (arrowSvg) arrowSvg.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
                } else {
                    parentLi.classList.add('sub-menu-open', 'sfHover');
                    if (toggleLink) toggleLink.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    if (subMenu) {
                        subMenu.classList.add('sub-menu-open');
                        subMenu.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
                    }
                    if (arrowSvg) arrowSvg.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
                }
            }

            if (toggleLink) {
                toggleLink.addEventListener('click', toggleDropdown);
            }
            var dropdownSpan = parentLi.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-toggle');
            if (dropdownSpan && dropdownSpan !== toggleLink) {
                dropdownSpan.addEventListener('click', toggleDropdown);
            }
        });

        // 3. Search Modal Controller
        function openSearch(e) {
            if (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
            }
            if (searchModal) {
                searchModal.classList.add('gp-modal--open');
                searchModal.style.display = 'flex';
                var inp = searchModal.querySelector('input[name="q"], input[type="search"]');
                if (inp) {
                    setTimeout(function() { inp.focus(); }, 60);
                }
            }
        }

        function closeSearch(e) {
            if (searchModal) {
                searchModal.classList.remove('gp-modal--open');
                searchModal.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        var searchBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-gpmodal-trigger="gp-search"], .icon-search, a[aria-controls="gp-search"]');
        searchBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', openSearch);
        });

        if (searchModal) {
            searchModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === searchModal || e.target.classList.contains('gp-modal__overlay') || e.target.hasAttribute('data-gpmodal-close')) {
                    closeSearch(e);
                }
            });

            var form = searchModal.querySelector('form');
            if (form) {
                form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                    var inp = form.querySelector('input[name="q"], input[type="search"]');
                    if (inp && inp.value.trim()) {
                        window.location.href = '/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(inp.value.trim());
                        e.preventDefault();
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) {
                closeSearch();
            }
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initStudyTopperNavigation);
    } else {
        initStudyTopperNavigation();
    }
})();
</script>

(function () {
    console.log("Ad popup script started");

    var DEBUG = true;
    var SESSION_KEY = "adPopupShown";
    var SCROLL_THRESHOLD = 0.5;
    var HISTORY_STATE = { adPopupOpen: true };

    var adDisplayed = false;
    var gptLoaded = false;
    var scrollTicking = false;
    var historyStatePushed = false;

    var adPopup = null;
    var closeBtn = null;

    function log() {
        if (!DEBUG) return;
        var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
        args.unshift("[AdPopup]");
        console.log.apply(console, args);
    }

    function warn() {
        if (!DEBUG) return;
        var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
        args.unshift("[AdPopup]");
        console.warn.apply(console, args);
    }

    function loadGPT(callback) {
        if (gptLoaded) {
            callback();
            return;
        }

        if (!window.googletag) {
            window.googletag = { cmd: [] };
        }

        var gptScript = document.createElement("script");
        gptScript.src = "https://securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/tag/js/gpt.js";
        gptScript.async = true;
        gptScript.onload = function () {
            gptLoaded = true;
            callback();
        };
        document.head.appendChild(gptScript);
    }

    function createPopup() {
        adPopup = document.createElement("div");
        adPopup.id = "ad-popup";
        adPopup.innerHTML =
            '<div id="popup-inner"><div id="close-popup">×</div><div id="ad-slot"></div></div>';

        document.body.appendChild(adPopup);

        adPopup.style.cssText =
            "position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100vh;display:none;justify-content:center;align-items:center;background:transparent;z-index:999999;pointer-events:none;";

        var inner = document.getElementById("popup-inner");
        inner.style.cssText =
            "position:relative;background:transparent;pointer-events:auto;";

        closeBtn = document.getElementById("close-popup");
        closeBtn.style.cssText =
            "position:absolute;top:-10px;right:-10px;width:26px;height:26px;background:#000;color:#fff;font-size:16px;display:none;justify-content:center;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;border-radius:50%;z-index:2;";

        var adBox = document.getElementById("ad-slot");
        adBox.style.cssText =
            "width:300px;height:250px;background:transparent;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;";

        closeBtn.onclick = closePopup;
    }

    function hidePopup() {
        if (adPopup) adPopup.style.display = "none";
    }

    function closePopup() {
        hidePopup();
        if (historyStatePushed) {
            history.back();
        }
    }

    function onPopState() {
        historyStatePushed = false;
        hidePopup();
    }

    function setupAd() {
        googletag.cmd.push(function () {

            googletag.pubads().collapseEmptyDivs();

            var slot = googletag.defineSlot(
                "/22479131132/MS_studytopperpopup",
                [300,250],
                "ad-slot"
            ).addService(googletag.pubads());

            googletag.enableServices();

            googletag.pubads().addEventListener("slotRenderEnded", function(event){

                if(event.slot === slot){

                    if(event.isEmpty){
                        hidePopup();
                    }else{

                        adPopup.style.display = "flex";
                        closeBtn.style.display = "flex";

                        sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY,"true");

                        history.pushState({adPopupOpen:true},"");
                        historyStatePushed = true;

                        window.addEventListener("popstate",onPopState);

                    }

                }

            });

        });
    }

    function showAd(){

        if(adDisplayed) return;

        adDisplayed = true;

        googletag.cmd.push(function(){
            googletag.display("ad-slot");
        });

        window.removeEventListener("scroll",onScroll);

    }

    function hasScrolledEnough(){

        var scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        var docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;

        return docHeight > 0 && (scrollTop/docHeight) >= SCROLL_THRESHOLD;

    }

    function onScroll(){

        if(adDisplayed || scrollTicking) return;

        scrollTicking = true;

        requestAnimationFrame(function(){

            scrollTicking = false;

            if(hasScrolledEnough()){

                loadGPT(function(){

                    setupAd();
                    showAd();

                });

            }

        });

    }

    function init(){

        if(sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY)==="true") return;

        if(document.getElementById("ad-popup")) return;

        createPopup();

        window.addEventListener("scroll",onScroll,{passive:true});

    }

    if(document.readyState==="loading"){
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",init);
    }else{
        init();
    }

})();

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // 1. Mobile Menu Toggle - 100% Exact GeneratePress Behavior
    var menuToggle = document.querySelector(".menu-toggle");
    var siteNav = document.getElementById("site-navigation");
    var primaryMenu = document.getElementById("primary-menu");
    
    if (menuToggle && siteNav) {
        menuToggle.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            var isToggled = siteNav.classList.contains("toggled");
            if (isToggled) {
                siteNav.classList.remove("toggled");
                menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
                if (primaryMenu) {
                    var ul = primaryMenu.querySelector("ul");
                    if (ul) ul.style.display = "none";
                }
            } else {
                siteNav.classList.add("toggled");
                menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
                if (primaryMenu) {
                    var ul = primaryMenu.querySelector("ul");
                    if (ul) ul.style.display = "block";
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // 2. Dropdown Sub-menu Toggle on Mobile
    var dropdownToggles = document.querySelectorAll(".menu-item-has-children > a, .dropdown-menu-toggle");
    dropdownToggles.forEach(function (dt) {
        dt.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            var parentLi = dt.closest(".menu-item-has-children");
            if (parentLi && window.innerWidth < 769) {
                var href = dt.getAttribute("href");
                if (!href || href === "#" || dt.classList.contains("dropdown-menu-toggle") || dt.closest(".dropdown-menu-toggle")) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
                parentLi.classList.toggle("sfHover");
                var subMenu = parentLi.querySelector(".sub-menu");
                if (subMenu) {
                    if (subMenu.style.display === "block") {
                        subMenu.style.display = "none";
                    } else {
                        subMenu.style.display = "block";
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    });

    // 3. Search Modal Trigger & Submission
    var searchTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-gpmodal-trigger="gp-search"], .icon-search, a[aria-controls="gp-search"]');
    var searchModal = document.getElementById("gp-search");

    function openSearchModal(e) {
        if (e) e.preventDefault();
        if (searchModal) {
            searchModal.classList.add("gp-modal--open", "is-active");
            searchModal.style.display = "flex";
            var input = searchModal.querySelector('input[name="s"], input[name="q"], input[type="search"]');
            if (input) {
                setTimeout(function () { input.focus(); }, 50);
            }
        }
    }

    function closeSearchModal(e) {
        if (searchModal) {
            searchModal.classList.remove("gp-modal--open", "is-active");
            searchModal.style.display = "none";
        }
    }

    searchTriggers.forEach(function (st) {
        st.addEventListener("click", openSearchModal);
    });

    if (searchModal) {
        var closeBtns = searchModal.querySelectorAll("[data-gpmodal-close], .gp-modal__close-btn, .gp-modal__overlay");
        closeBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                if (e.target === btn || btn.hasAttribute("data-gpmodal-close") || btn.classList.contains("gp-modal__close-btn")) {
                    closeSearchModal(e);
                }
            });
        });

        searchModal.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            if (e.target === searchModal || e.target.classList.contains("gp-modal__overlay")) {
                closeSearchModal(e);
            }
        });

        var form = searchModal.querySelector("form");
        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var input = form.querySelector('input[name="s"], input[name="q"], input[type="search"]');
                var val = input ? input.value.trim() : "";
                if (val) {
                    window.location.href = "/search?q=" + encodeURIComponent(val);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Escape" || e.keyCode === 27) {
            closeSearchModal();
        }
    });
});
</script>

<script id="st-nav-search-scripts">
(function() {
    function initStudyTopperNavigation() {
        var siteNav = document.getElementById('site-navigation');
        var menuBtn = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
        var mainNav = document.getElementById('primary-menu');
        var searchModal = document.getElementById('gp-search');

        if (!siteNav || !menuBtn) return;
        if (siteNav.dataset.stNavV2Initialized === 'true') return;
        siteNav.dataset.stNavV2Initialized = 'true';

        // 1. Mobile Hamburger Menu Toggle
        var lastMenuToggleTs = 0;
        function handleMenuToggle(e) {
            var now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastMenuToggleTs < 250) return;
            lastMenuToggleTs = now;
            if (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
            }
            var isCurrentlyToggled = siteNav.classList.contains('toggled');
            if (isCurrentlyToggled) {
                siteNav.classList.remove('toggled');
                menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                if (mainNav) mainNav.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                siteNav.classList.add('toggled');
                menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                if (mainNav) mainNav.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        menuBtn.addEventListener('click', handleMenuToggle);

        // 2. 'More' / Submenu Dropdown Controller
        var moreParents = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-has-children');
        moreParents.forEach(function(parentLi) {
            var toggleLink = parentLi.querySelector(':scope > a') || parentLi.querySelector('a');
            var subMenu = parentLi.querySelector(':scope > .sub-menu') || parentLi.querySelector('.sub-menu');
            var arrowSvg = parentLi.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-toggle svg') || parentLi.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-toggle');
            var lastToggleTs = 0;

            function toggleDropdown(e) {
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastToggleTs < 250) return;
                lastToggleTs = now;
                if (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                }
                var isOpen = parentLi.classList.contains('sub-menu-open') || (subMenu && subMenu.classList.contains('sub-menu-open'));
                if (isOpen) {
                    parentLi.classList.remove('sub-menu-open', 'sfHover');
                    if (toggleLink) toggleLink.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    if (subMenu) {
                        subMenu.classList.remove('sub-menu-open');
                        subMenu.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    }
                    if (arrowSvg) arrowSvg.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
                } else {
                    parentLi.classList.add('sub-menu-open', 'sfHover');
                    if (toggleLink) toggleLink.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    if (subMenu) {
                        subMenu.classList.add('sub-menu-open');
                        subMenu.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
                    }
                    if (arrowSvg) arrowSvg.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
                }
            }

            if (toggleLink) {
                toggleLink.addEventListener('click', toggleDropdown);
            }
            var dropdownSpan = parentLi.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-toggle');
            if (dropdownSpan && dropdownSpan !== toggleLink) {
                dropdownSpan.addEventListener('click', toggleDropdown);
            }
        });

        // 3. Search Modal Controller
        function openSearch(e) {
            if (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
            }
            if (searchModal) {
                searchModal.classList.add('gp-modal--open');
                searchModal.style.display = 'flex';
                var inp = searchModal.querySelector('input[name="q"], input[type="search"]');
                if (inp) {
                    setTimeout(function() { inp.focus(); }, 60);
                }
            }
        }

        function closeSearch(e) {
            if (searchModal) {
                searchModal.classList.remove('gp-modal--open');
                searchModal.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        var searchBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-gpmodal-trigger="gp-search"], .icon-search, a[aria-controls="gp-search"]');
        searchBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', openSearch);
        });

        if (searchModal) {
            searchModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === searchModal || e.target.classList.contains('gp-modal__overlay') || e.target.hasAttribute('data-gpmodal-close')) {
                    closeSearch(e);
                }
            });

            var form = searchModal.querySelector('form');
            if (form) {
                form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                    var inp = form.querySelector('input[name="q"], input[type="search"]');
                    if (inp && inp.value.trim()) {
                        window.location.href = '/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(inp.value.trim());
                        e.preventDefault();
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) {
                closeSearch();
            }
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initStudyTopperNavigation);
    } else {
        initStudyTopperNavigation();
    }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
